Getting here from Hapjeong, Sangsu and Hongik University Station

The restaurant is at 서울 마포구 독막로7길 5, 1층 (1F, 5 Dongmak-ro 7-gil, Mapo-gu, Seoul). Match the Korean sign 홍대화덕피자 and the entrance in the photograph.

Approximate walking times

Allow about 5 minutes on foot from Hapjeong or Sangsu Station, or about 15 minutes from Hongik University Station. These are approximate walking times. Check the route on Naver before leaving.

Station exits and the entrance

For a shorter walk, meet at Hapjeong Exit 6 (Lines 2 and 6) or Sangsu Exit 1 (Line 6). If you are already near Hongik University Station, allow about 15 minutes. Set your starting point to the station exit in the walking directions and use the exterior photo to identify our ground-floor entrance on Dongmak-ro 7-gil.
